hotspots: Stage breakdown: vocoder causal overlap-save loop takes ~55% of time (680-750ms for 7 chunks), 8-step sampler takes ~38% of time (460-510ms for 108 frames), text-encoder & duration combined <3% (<50ms). Preprocessing/RUAccent takes 20-50ms per sentence.

description: Preload all voice style embeddings into RAM during engine initialization

asi.hypothesis: Redundant disk reads of style_ttl.npy and style_dp.npy during synthesis requests introduce latency and file system call overhead
asi.evidence: Audits showed style_ttl.npy (51.2 KB) was read from disk on every synthesis call
asi.result: Statistically accepted with 2.37% improvement exceeding 2x MAD threshold
asi.bottleneck: Vocoder causal overlap-save loop and latent frame extraction
asi.next_action_hint: Eliminate redundant allocations in slice_latent_frames and vocoder audio slicing

description: Reuse latent window vector across vocoder streaming iterations

asi.hypothesis: Reallocating latent_window per 16-frame vocoder chunk causes memory churn
asi.evidence: Profile showed vocoder loop runs 7 times for 100+ frame audio
asi.result: No statistically significant improvement (delta +0.015s, within noise); ONNX Tensor::from_array still requires owned buffer
asi.bottleneck: Actual ONNX runtime computation in vocoder/sampler dominates minor vector allocations
asi.next_action_hint: Look into RUAccent homograph tokenization / text processing where multiple regexes and hash maps run

description: Pre-warm speechfront normalizer at server startup and eliminate redundant case conversions in RUAccent loop

asi.hypothesis: Lazy loading of TOML normalizer and redundant string conversions in ruaccent homograph loop add latency spikes
asi.evidence: Profiling showed speech-front normalization on first request parses 1160-line TOML synchronously, adding 20-50ms
asi.result: Statistically accepted with 7.73% latency reduction (confidence 26.38, well above 2x MAD)
asi.next_action_hint: Benchmark holdout set and finalize campaign
